title: Mountaineer Military Museum

services.name: Barb’s Guided Tour
services.desc: Step inside and experience the stories, history, and hidden details that make this destination so special. In this guided tour, Barb shares a personal and informative walk-through filled with local insight, memorable stories, and unique points of interest that visitors often overlook. Whether you are planning a visit or simply exploring from home, this tour offers a closer look at the people, places, and history that help define the Mountaineer spirit. While Barb takes you on this guided tour, always remember "the promise" that built this treasure. This video experience was created to give visitors a more personal look at the people, memories, and moments connected to this special place.
